title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 May 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 14 May 2026 The low pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. This system is expected to move away from Sri Lanka during the next 48 hours according to the latest weather analysis based on May 14th morning. Cloudy skies are expected over most parts of the island. Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern provinces and in Anuradhapura, Galle and Matara districts. Heavy showers above 100mm are likely at some places in Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Puttalam, Galle and Matara districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at some places in Uva province after 1.00 pm. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
